name: release-notes
description: Turns a list of merged changes into customer-facing release notes.

# Release notes

Use this Skill when a release is ready and its notes have not been drafted.

1. Read the list of merged changes for the release.
2. Group the changes by the area of the product each one touches.
3. Write one sentence per group in the customer's vocabulary.
4. Record the drafted notes on the release record.

## Ordering

Put the groups a customer asked about first, then the rest in the order the
areas appear in the product.
